owner_request: Complete activity context, latency, natural speech and both-speaker checks, preserving one Eva.
changes: Public action history now contains validated bounded observation fragments and precise lifecycle states.
Activity uses actual recorded action times, including completion of an earlier-day request.
Grouped exact-source database joins avoid repeated journal scans; no memory cache, second store or extra model.
Core-authored speech favors useful content and direct source-backed follow-up over empty lookup announcements.
Empty input noise preserves an unspoken final answer and approved first part. New words and STOP still revoke old speech.
Farewell settles provisional input before closing; cancelled audio is not replayed.
Long approved speech splits on sentence/word boundaries while preserving all text.
boundaries: Public observations only after retained source, current authority, erasure, original actor and receipt validation.
Original request and action times remain separate; verified transport does not prove business success.
1200 characters per result and6000 per page; paging/session bounds remain explicit.
No claim that pending audio was heard; absolute lifetime/STOP and cancellation remain enforced.
Concurrent private-history integration was preserved; its separate implementation/acceptance belongs to E2.7.

validation.independent_review: review_cursor: activity source and both grouped joins, voice instruction changes and final media hash approved; two discovered audio edge cases repaired before installation.
validation.baseline_regressions: New cross-midnight/result regression failed before fix; installed-image empty-noise probe discarded one completed unspoken answer.
validation.fixture_limits: Isolated tmpfs PostgreSQL with current schema fixtures and exact candidate public modules. Early exact-base attempts failed only because current schema fixtures and old image metadata differed; no production schema change.

latency.limit: Small sequential samples with uncontrolled shared memory/provider load; no p95 or universal speed claim. Core timing excludes acoustic input/output; memory still took6.7–7.9s in the two core probes.

consumption.normal_Eva_runtime_usage: not included; no fabricated zero-cost claim
consumption.scope: Development validation only; includes measured completed provider phases above. Invalidated attempt, voice inference accounting and assistant development consumption are incomplete/unknown. Ordinary household runtime is excluded.

concurrent_installation: Stale core manifest was rejected before replacement. Rebased only household_continuity and voice_context onto newly installed actual core/worker images; preserved E2.7 recent_activity and all other code/configuration.
operational_observation: Two media readiness RemoteProtocolError exceptions occurred during the coordinated core restart, at10:32:55Z and10:33:00Z; core started10:32:58Z. Subsequent current readiness checks succeed; no startup error or service restart loop.
remaining: Owner listening on both physical speakers; subjective naturalness and acoustic first-word/noise behavior cannot be certified by synthetic tests. Shared memory/provider latency remains variable; optimization is measured, no universal response-time promise.

media.post_startup_error_classification: Known transient readiness HTTP failures during core replacement; classified by coordinator against restart timestamps. Current binding readiness checked independently below.

speaker_readiness.scope: Read-only readiness, source hashes, process health and transport counts; no acoustic or heard-word assertion. Error flags are bounded log-pattern checks. Prior media ASGI failures are retained and classified separately from current readiness.

full_audio_integration.scope: Synthetic PCM through real listener, same installed core image in a temporary HTTP instance with background work disabled, real renderer, local sink. No household microphone or physical speaker used.
full_audio_integration.timing_limit: Turn1 first_audio_ms is carry-over from deliberately interrupted previous output, not response latency. Other turn times include injected speech duration and provider processing; no stable latency benchmark.
full_audio_integration.interrupted_first_attempt: A concurrent core installation terminated the third request after two completed turns. Its session then lost renewal; preserved as invalidated integration attempt. Repeated on an isolated instance of the same actual image.
